# PragOptics

> PragOptics is the data-visualization and field-data platform for industrial automation, and the maker of OmniBus, a universal HART communicator and calibration recorder. PragOptics is a brand of Fortiview Holdings.

PragOptics turns every HART instrument connection into an auditable, certifiable record. The flagship product, OmniBus, is a handheld field node that speaks vendor-neutral HART across manufacturers and produces finished As-Found / As-Left calibration certificates as a by-product of doing the job.

## What OmniBus is

- Universal, vendor-neutral HART communicator: works HART field instruments regardless of manufacturer, with no per-vendor descriptor licensing.
- Calibration recorder: guided, tolerance-based multi-point calibration with on-device trims (PV Zero, DAC Zero, DAC Gain) and automatic read-back.
- On-board 4-20 mA measurement: a built-in milliamp circuit measures real loop current directly, rather than trusting the device's reported value, and writes the trusted value into the record.
- Connectivity: USB HART, on-board two-wire loop (banana jacks), HART-IP over Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, plus built-in LTE and GNSS. Modbus support is planned via software update.
- Audit trail: an append-only historian records every HART exchange and the full write lifecycle (requested, sent, response, read-back, result), answering who did what, when, where, and why.
- PULSE scores device health continuously from local evidence; Atlas runs safe-read deep capability profiling on demand.
- Ownership: a one-time device purchase used locally forever. The PragOptics Field Node Manager desktop app is free. PragOptics Cloud Sync is an optional subscription.

PragOptics is a platform: OmniBus is one field node within it, feeding the Field Node Manager, an optional SharePoint (SPFx) visualizer, and an optional PragOptics cloud system of record.

## HART resources

- [What Is HART? A Field Guide to HART Communication](https://pragoptics.com/hart/what-is-hart/): how digital HART rides on the 4-20 mA loop, HART commands, DD/DTM, HART-IP, and calibration.
- [HART Glossary](https://pragoptics.com/hart/glossary/): 38 key HART terms including HART-IP, WirelessHART, FSK, burst mode, DD, DTM, NE43, As-Found / As-Left, and trim.
- [HART Communication FAQ](https://pragoptics.com/hart/faq/): answer-first responses on how HART works, what a HART communicator is, HART vs 4-20 mA, HART-IP, WirelessHART, and As-Found / As-Left calibration.
- [HART resource hub](https://pragoptics.com/hart/): landing page linking the guides above.
